query:
SELECT postid AS "post_id!",
                   createat AS "create_at!",
                   lastsentat AS "last_sent_at!",
                   deleteat AS "delete_at!",
                   sentcount AS "sent_count!"
              FROM persistentnotifications
             WHERE deleteat = 0
               AND createat <= $1
               AND lastsentat <= $1
               AND sentcount < $2
             LIMIT $3
